_about: Small venues whose own schedules we read directly (fomo misses or under-covers them). type: 'ics' (a calendar feed URL) 'squarespace' (a Squarespace events page; ?format=json is added) or 'eventbrite' (an Eventbrite organizer page; each event page's schema.org data is read). Their events count as 'Local venue' picks.

venues.note: Live music nightly from 9pm, two sets.
Indoor hydroponic farm in Prospect Heights: tastings, workshops, trivia and bingo nights.
Ukrainian, Russian and English bookshop in Prospect Heights (formerly MyBiblioteka): author talks, lectures and workshops, many in Russian.
